description.value: Down to Earth Health Shop is a health food store and in-house café in Fort Nelson, a remote northern BC community on the Alaska Highway. Alongside its retail health food selection, it runs a café with a rotating daily menu of freshly prepared hot dishes including soups, sandwiches, calzones, and salads. For cyclists traveling the remote northern BC interior, it offers a rare combination of specialty groceries and made-to-order hot food.
